newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS ugrades Alcan outlook to positive.
newsitem.headline: CBRS ugrades Alcan outlook to positive.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday that it confirmed the ratings of Alcan Aluminium Ltd and upgraded its rating outlook to positive from stable.
CBRS said it confirmed Alcan's credit ratings of A-1 on Alcan's commercial paper, A(Low) on its long-term debt and P-2(Low) on its preferred shares after completing its review of first-half results.

"The rating outlook on all of Alcan's outstanding fixed-income securites is upgraded to positive from the current stable position owing to strong prospects for strong aluminum demand to continue in 1997-98 and an improving in credit profile of the company," the agency said.
Alcan is poised to continue generating strong cashflow from cost effective utilizatioan of its large generating capacity and world-wide distribution operations, CBRS said.
The company's favourable cost structure and debt position should allow it to report stronger earnings and enhance credit protection for the second half of 1997, the agency said.

Alcan's product portfolio and geographic diversified manufacturing operations, combined with demand recovery and favourable pricing movement augurs well for the credit quality of its outstanding debt and preferred securities, CBRS said.
